title: instrument.json — the instrument manifest
description: Build-time manifest for Brief Instruments (PLAN-2026-06-09-brief-instruments). The REGISTRY copy written at first release is authoritative for scope enforcement (iOS reads scopes from the registry, never from the bundle); this file is the worker's declaration, byte-compared at the release gate. scopes are WRITE-ONCE: a revision changing them is refused (Agency Art 19 rule 2). schemaVersion is additive-only: bump it ONLY for additive storage-shape changes; reverts across a bump are blocked.

instrument.description: false in the template default (normal hosted apps); the commission sets true, which flips the instrument layout/profile at build time.

name.description: The instrument's byline name, chosen with the user at commissioning (e.g. "Arnold").

appId.description: The hosted-olive appId (<lowercased-uid>-<slug>); also the custom-scheme host the tile is pinned to.

version.description: Informational app version; the serving source of truth is hosted-apps currentVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Per-instrument storage schema version. ADDITIVE-ONLY; the release gate refuses non-monotonic or >+1 bumps and blocks reverts across a bump.

scopes.description: Declared data scopes — the consent sheet's ingredients. WRITE-ONCE at first release.

ingest.description: Required iff scopes includes 'ingest'. Declares the sender filter for email→instrument routing.

senderFilter.description: Case-insensitive sender substrings (e.g. "@withings.com") the relay routes into apps/{appId}/ingest.

benchmark.description: The commission's pass bar, mirrored from eval/CONTRACT.md.
